hooks.name: Probe guard: the agent never probes the Internet
hooks.description: Refuses any agent shell command that probes the network (traceroute, tracert, mtr, ping, nmap, tracepath) toward a host absent from .kiro/probe-allowlist.txt (loopback and RFC 5737/3849 documentation ranges only). The script reads the Kiro payload on stdin (hook_event_name, cwd, session_id, tool_name, tool_input), finds the probe command and its target, and exits non-zero with a message on stderr so Kiro blocks the tool and relays the message. Every block is journaled: the count is submission fact 1 of §14.6. Annexe D: the exact field carrying the command inside tool_input is to be confirmed on the first real trigger.
